name: Creature Type Origination Methods and Compatibility
scope: General tabletop origination-method defaults, not an executable Character Origins builder or automatic Species/Ancestry grants.

methodDefinitions.name: Biological reproduction
methodDefinitions.description: A living contributor reproduces by an appropriate biological process; the specific process establishes contributions and prerequisites.

methodDefinitions.name: Plant reproduction
methodDefinitions.description: A distinct Plant origination family that can later define pollination, fertilization, spores, or other plant/fungal processes without assuming animal reproduction.

methodDefinitions.name: Construct assembly
methodDefinitions.description: Materials, design, assembly, and any animating force may play different input roles; creator Species traits are not inherited automatically.

methodDefinitions.name: Elemental manifestation
methodDefinitions.description: Elemental beings may coalesce or manifest from elemental or magical sources; specific processes and component roles are defined by the Species or scenario.

methodDefinitions.name: Spawning
methodDefinitions.description: A nonbiological or otherwise distinct spawning process, with its own input requirements and permitted contributors.

methodDefinitions.name: Division
methodDefinitions.description: Creation through separation of an existing creature or mass, subject to individual creature rules.

methodDefinitions.name: Reanimation
methodDefinitions.description: An existing creature or remains becomes animated through an applicable process; this does not imply biological descent.

methodDefinitions.name: Transformation
methodDefinitions.description: An existing individual changes its configuration or type under an explicit effect or process; existing Heritage is not erased by relabeling.

methodInheritance.rule: A creature type inherits the nearest explicitly authored list along its type-parent chain. Its own list replaces that default; a Species or Ancestry may explicitly add, restrict, or replace applicable methods.
methodInheritance.emptyListMeans: no general method granted; not an absolute ban

compatibility.biologicalAndPlantReproduction: A contributing creature must support the selected reproductive method or be specifically authorized to participate. Different creature types are not inherently incompatible.
compatibility.specificProcessRequirements: Apply the selected process's contributor roles, number of required inputs, and explicit restrictions, including full-set conditions; do not assume exactly two parents.
compatibility.unknown: Unsupported or undocumented combinations remain unresolved under first-party rules, not categorically forbidden.
compatibility.explicitRestrictions: A type, Species, Ancestry, or origination process can impose a more specific restriction.
compatibility.dmOverride: The DM can explicitly authorize otherwise unsupported combinations and record the decision without changing first-party defaults.
compatibility.distinctFromManifestation: Compatibility and origination do not automatically grant source characteristics, choose an effective creature type, or establish mechanical coherence.

reviewNotes: First-party method support is intentionally permissive and incomplete; an individual creature can have an exception and a type can have multiple methods.
Plant reproduction is a distinct method, not the generic biological-reproduction method.
Genies remain Elementals; their potential for biological offspring is Species-specific and does not require all Elementals to support biological reproduction.
Removing Monstrous Humanoid and True Elemental does not automatically change preexisting monster stat blocks, material-body properties, or targeting semantics of other types.
The general rules remain understandable and usable at the table without Rules Core software.
